name: fix-catchup
about: Issue #73: catch-up experience (fix_catchup bot). A fresh level 1 paladin has no bonus in town. Bandit Keep at NG+1 shows the Late Bloomer buff and hwp xp 40 gives 60; checked against NG+0 the buff ends and 40 gives 40; NG+2 turns it on with threshold 25; catchup.enabled off ends it; levelling to 20 at NG+1 ends it (level 20 >= 20).

steps.pattern: \[HWP:catchup\] ready: buff loaded, thresholds NG\+1 20, NG\+2 25
